@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@[[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 350@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@0.25@@cost@@35@@cooldown@@9 / 8 / 7 / 6 / 5@@targeting@@Auto@@damagetype@@Magic@@spellshield@@True@@projectile@@{{{projectile}}}@@notes@@ * A [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]]'s [[File:Basic Attack.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Basic damage]] [[:Damage|basic damage]] and each [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effect are all separate damage instances, and may be reduced each if they deal physical damage. * ''Tantrum's'' cooldown reduction will trigger multiple times for effects such as [[File:Master Yi Double Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Master Yi#Double Strike|An icon for Master Yi's ability Double Strike]] [[Master Yi#Double Strike|Double Strike]] and [[File:Guinsoo's Rageblade item.png|20xpx|border|link=Guinsoo's Rageblade|An icon for the item Guinsoo's Rageblade]] [[Guinsoo's Rageblade|Guinsoo's Rageblade's]] ''Phantom Hit''. ** The cooldown will be reduced, even if the incoming attack is [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]]. ** The cooldown will not be reduced, if the incoming attack misses due to the enemy being [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.@@
